column1: # source: qtbase@6.12.0 (the installed Qt 6, qVersion() at run time)
# inputs: a:colour b:colour c:colour inner:number outer:number
# written by generate.py; do not edit. Each row is KColorUtils::mix(a, KColorUtils::mix(b, c, inner), outer),
# the inner result passed on as the QColor KColorUtils returned. a, b, c: the model's f32 channels,
# entered as QColor::fromRgbF; `#rrggbb[aa]` is 8-bit channels over 255. inner, outer: the decimal text
# parsed as the double (qreal) passed. result: the result's QColor channels as floats, unrounded (every
# result is QColor::Rgb); result16: QColor::rgba64()'s 16-bit channels; result8: QColor's 8-bit getters
# Rows: the builder's call (kde.rs lay_system_over, button.default_button_border_color: a highlight,
# b button background, c button foreground, inner frame_contrast, outer 0.5) for kde.rs LIGHT (=
# tests/fixtures/kde/breeze-light.ini), kde.rs DARK, breeze-dark.ini and custom-accent.ini, inner
# 0..1; the outer factor's ends and 0.25 at inner 0.2; the window and view sets toward the highlight;
# translucent and transparent inputs; then 20 seeded random inputs (seed 20261123).
# The harness's single mix reproduces rc1's tests/vectors/kcu_mix.tsv (kguiaddons@6.31.0 compiled from
# source, x86-64 baseline) on 88 of its 88 rows.
